name: Bibliography Path Audit
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Before you copy a path candidate, read its format sample. It shows if the file looks like the BibTeX or CSL JSON format that your citation settings expect.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bibliography Path Audit is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.

related.name: Local Citation Page Jump
related.blurb: Open a local PDF at the page number given in an existing citation.

related.name: Pandoc Crossref Preview
related.blurb: Show figure and equation reference numbers from Pandoc labels while you read a note.

related.name: Note RIS Export
related.blurb: Map reference note properties to fields in a local RIS file.
